title: USB Condenser Microphone Set For Home Computer Recording
body_html:
Product information :

Microphone Type: Condenser
Applicable objects: home, computer, recording
Dimensions: 255*105*55MM
Wireless: yes
Pointing characteristics: supercardioid pointing
Channels: 2
Input voltage: 5V
With or without bracket: Yes
Bluetooth Protocol: No Bluetooth
Color: standard, set, standard + small anti-splash

Microphone technical parameters:
Directivity: supercardioid finger ring
Sensitivity: -36db plus or minus 1db
Frequency response: 20HZ-20KHZ
Output impedance: 150 ohms
Current consumption: 20mA
Power supply mode: USB power supply (5VDC)
Output interface: USB interface
Specifications (sizes): standard line length 2 meters
Body material: aluminum alloy
Sampling: 48000HZ/ 16Bit


Packing list：

Microphone*1 +Data cable*1+Sponge cover*1 +Tyepe-c adapter*1
or
Microphone*1 +Data cable*1+Sponge cover*1 +Tyepe-c adapter*1+Small blowout net*1
or
Microphone*1 +Data cable*1+Sponge cover*1 +Tyepe-c adapter+Bracket*1
